Oddtoe designs characters with a sketch. Or several. The tools for designing characters are simply a pencil and a glorious blank sheet of note paper. Designing characters has changed so much in the past twenty years. Digital tools are certainly embedded now in a character designer's process. Think: Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, Procreate. Think of scanners and 3d printers. And now let's drop in the 'most controversial elephant in the room': generative AI.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_column_text]Personal influences of mine are Winsor McCay, Walt Disney, Charles Schulz, or Bill Waterson: a great cartoon character is a great personality, designed to be a part of a wider story. These illustrated or animated characters are the actors in their plays. Hollywood also asks them to be intellectual property (IP) and to be the next thing to entertain us across movies, TV, and video games. So if you or your company are looking for a unique character designer for hire for just these purposes, look no further.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_column_text]Oddtoe specializes in 2d and 3d character design. I love a detailed brief. I'll take a mood board or other character sheets. And of course, a script is perfect to discover how a character is portrayed in writing. I've got a style for the design of characters. Realism isn't my thing; big heads are. Have a look through my portfolio and you'll get a sense of the style of character designs I like to conjure up. Once I've settled on a character's[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_column_text] physical design, I'll often return to the drawing board. Settling for a Disney or Pixar cookie-cutter character isn't going to happen on my watch, so I often add more detail and uniqueness to any second draft. I want to avoid visual clichés. Villains and the main protagonists of a story often get finer attention and here I often take on influences from other artists. First, as inspiration. Second, to make sure I'm designing a character that's unlike anyone else out there.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="55" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="55" screen_tablet_spacer_size="55" screen_mobile_spacer_size="45"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][dfd_delimiter delimiter_style="dfd-delimiter-with-icon" icon_size="15" delimiter_border_style="dotted" icon_fontawesome="fas fa-question-circle" show_icon="enable_icon"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row dfd_enable_overlay="" css=".vc_custom_1690353985120{background-color: #c6acb6 !important;}"][vc_column width="1/4"][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/2"][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="40" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="30" screen_tablet_spacer_size="20" screen_mobile_spacer_size="20"][vc_column_text item_animation="transition.fadeIn"]

Questions about

CHARACTER DESIGN?

[/vc_column_text][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="40" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="30" screen_tablet_spacer_size="20" screen_mobile_spacer_size="20"][dfd_accordion style="style-4" active_section="1" font_size="18" tab_title_google_fonts="yes" tab_title_custom_fonts="font_family:Arvo%3Aregular%2Citalic%2C700%2C700italic|font_style:700%20bold%20regular%3A700%3Anormal" icon_size="14" tab_text_color="#000000"][vc_tta_section title="Can I see more examples of Oddtoe's character designs?" tab_id="1685677784578-172f9372-59216fce-87a6"][vc_column_text]

Absolutely. I think the best place to see my character design style is to check out my panel comics on Instagram.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="What type of projects does Oddtoe work on?" tab_id="1685677784323-438be9dd-da0e6fce-87a6"][vc_column_text]

Books, web series comics, video games, and projects where the character designer is part of a larger production like animated TV shows and movies.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="Who are the best types of characters to design in your job?" tab_id="1685677784395-526dd6ff-b9c26fce-87a6"][vc_column_text]

The juicier characters are the stupid ones, the over-the-top characters, villains, nerds, the overly vain characters, and the ones that have a bizarre way of looking at the world. It's not hard to get into those.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="How do you hire a character designer?" tab_id="faqchar-1-2026"][vc_column_text css=""]

Send the brief — what the character is for, the medium it has to work in, and the style you are drawn to. Oddtoe takes character design for books, comics, games, animated series and films, either as a full commission or as a design pass over characters you already have.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="What does a character design service include?" tab_id="faqchar-2-2026"][vc_column_text css=""]

Usually concept sketches, a settled character sheet, and the artwork a production needs to work from. Exact deliverables and the number of revision rounds are agreed with the brief so nothing is open-ended.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="What makes a good character designer?" tab_id="faqchar-3-2026"][vc_column_text css=""]

Range, and judgement about which sketch is the one. A good character designer can push a face past realistic into something readable at a glance. Oddtoe leans to the over-the-top — villains, nerds, the overly vain, and characters with a bizarre way of looking at the world.

CHARACTER DESIGNER [/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row dfd_row_responsive_enable=”dfd-row-responsive-enable” responsive_styles=”padding_left_mobile:10|padding_right_mobile:10″ css=”.vc_custom_1690353080939{background-color: #c6acb6 !important;}”][vc_column]

Experienced cartoonist, animator, and 3d modeller at your service

Character Designer for Hire

[vc_row_inner dfd_row_responsive_enable=”dfd-row-responsive-enable” responsive_styles=”padding_left_desktop:10|padding_right_desktop:10″][vc_column_inner el_class=”dfd_col-tablet-12″ width=”1/3″ dfd_column_responsive_enable=”dfd-column-responsive-enable” css=”.vc_custom_1496122660301{padding-right: 2% !important;}” offset=”vc_col-lg-4 vc_col-md-4 vc_col-xs-12″ responsive_styles=”padding_right_tablet:20|padding_right_mobile:10″]

Unique Style of Visual Humor

Caricatures, creatures or one-of-kind new character design for animations, games, and commercials.

Digital Character Art & Spec Sheets

Quality of character design and documentation for modern studios & global ad agencies.
[/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class=”dfd_col-tablet-12″ width=”1/3″ offset=”vc_col-lg-4 vc_col-md-4 vc_col-xs-12″]
[/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class=”dfd_col-tablet-12″ width=”1/3″ dfd_column_responsive_enable=”dfd-column-responsive-enable” css=”.vc_custom_1496122671238{padding-left: 2% !important;}” offset=”vc_col-lg-4 vc_col-md-4 vc_col-xs-12″ responsive_styles=”padding_left_tablet:20|padding_left_mobile:10″]

Characters with Personality

Oddtoe doesn’t play it safe. The best character designers take risks and design on the edge.

Character IP

A character designer who can assist in creating intellectual property.
[/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row dfd_enable_overlay=”” anchor=”buy” css=”.vc_custom_1690353094623{background-color: #c6acb6 !important;}”][vc_column]
[/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row dfd_enable_overlay=”” css=”.vc_custom_1690353108373{background-color: #c6acb6 !important;}”][vc_column][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner col_inner_shadow=”box_shadow_enable:disable|shadow_horizontal:0|shadow_vertical:15|shadow_blur:50|shadow_spread:0|box_shadow_color:rgba(0%2C0%2C0%2C.35)” col_inner_shadow_hover=”box_shadow_enable:disable|shadow_horizontal:0|shadow_vertical:15|shadow_blur:50|shadow_spread:0|box_shadow_color:rgba(0%2C0%2C0%2C.35)”]

Looking for a new breed of character design?

Character Designer in Melbourne, Australia & Los Angeles

[/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/4″][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/4″][vc_column_text]First. Oddtoe designs characters with a sketch. Or several. The tools for designing characters are simply a pencil and a glorious blank sheet of note paper. Designing characters has changed so much in the past twenty years. Digital tools are certainly embedded now in a character designer’s process. Think: Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, Procreate. Think of scanners and 3d printers. And now let’s drop in the ‘most controversial elephant in the room’: generative AI.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/4″][vc_column_text]Personal influences of mine are Winsor McCay, Walt Disney, Charles Schulz, or Bill Waterson: a great cartoon character is a great personality, designed to be a part of a wider story. These illustrated or animated characters are the actors in their plays. Hollywood also asks them to be intellectual property (IP) and to be the next thing to entertain us across movies, TV, and video games. So if you or your company are looking for a unique character designer for hire for just these purposes, look no further.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/4″][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner]
Contact OddtoeContact Oddtoe
[/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row dfd_enable_overlay=”” dfd_row_config=”default_row_small_paddings” one_page_title=”What?” anchor=”what” dfd_row_parallax=”dfd-row-parallax” dfd_row_responsive_enable=”dfd-row-responsive-enable” responsive_styles=”padding_left_mobile:10|padding_right_mobile:10″ css=”.vc_custom_1690353128316{background-color: #c6acb6 !important;}”][vc_column]

Show some character...

Types of Character Designs

[vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/3″ col_inner_shadow=”box_shadow_enable:disable|shadow_horizontal:0|shadow_vertical:15|shadow_blur:50|shadow_spread:0|box_shadow_color:rgba(0%2C0%2C0%2C.35)” col_inner_shadow_hover=”box_shadow_enable:disable|shadow_horizontal:0|shadow_vertical:15|shadow_blur:50|shadow_spread:0|box_shadow_color:rgba(0%2C0%2C0%2C.35)”]

  • 2d Illustration

    Traditional pen-and-ink or digital designs

[/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/3″]

  • 2.5 Dimensional

    Shaded in a way to feel more real

[/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/3″]

  • 3d Models

    Characters designed for animation or games

[/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner]
[vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner]
[/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row dfd_enable_overlay=”” css=”.vc_custom_1690353141634{background-color: #c6acb6 !important;}”][vc_column][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner col_inner_shadow=”box_shadow_enable:disable|shadow_horizontal:0|shadow_vertical:15|shadow_blur:50|shadow_spread:0|box_shadow_color:rgba(0%2C0%2C0%2C.35)” col_inner_shadow_hover=”box_shadow_enable:disable|shadow_horizontal:0|shadow_vertical:15|shadow_blur:50|shadow_spread:0|box_shadow_color:rgba(0%2C0%2C0%2C.35)”]

Bring to life a new style of character.

THE WORK OF A UNIQUE CHARACTER DESIGNER

[/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/4″][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/4″][vc_column_text]Oddtoe specializes in 2d and 3d character design. I love a detailed brief. I’ll take a mood board or other character sheets. And of course, a script is perfect to discover how a character is portrayed in writing. I’ve got a style for the design of characters. Realism isn’t my thing; big heads are. Have a look through my portfolio and you’ll get a sense of the style of character designs I like to conjure up.

Once I’ve settled on a character’s[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/4″][vc_column_text] physical design, I’ll often return to the drawing board. Settling for a Disney or Pixar cookie-cutter character isn’t going to happen on my watch, so I often add more detail and uniqueness to any second draft. I want to avoid visual clichés. Villains and the main protagonists of a story often get finer attention and here I often take on influences from other artists. First, as inspiration. Second, to make sure I’m designing a character that’s unlike anyone else out there.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/4″][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner]

[/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner]
[/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row dfd_enable_overlay=”” css=”.vc_custom_1690353985120{background-color: #c6acb6 !important;}”][vc_column width=”1/4″][/vc_column][vc_column width=”1/2″]
[vc_column_text item_animation=”transition.fadeIn”]

Questions about

CHARACTER DESIGN?

[/vc_column_text]

[dfd_accordion style=”style-4″ active_section=”1″ font_size=”18″ tab_title_google_fonts=”yes” tab_title_custom_fonts=”font_family:Arvo%3Aregular%2Citalic%2C700%2C700italic|font_style:700%20bold%20regular%3A700%3Anormal” icon_size=”14″ tab_text_color=”#000000″][vc_tta_section title=”Can I see more examples of Oddtoe’s character designs?” tab_id=”1685677784578-172f9372-59216fce-87a6″][vc_column_text]

Absolutely. I think the best place to see my character design style is to check out my panel comics on Instagram.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”What type of projects does Oddtoe work on?” tab_id=”1685677784323-438be9dd-da0e6fce-87a6″][vc_column_text]

Books, web series comics, video games, and projects where the character designer is part of a larger production like animated TV shows and movies.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Who are the best types of characters to design in your job?” tab_id=”1685677784395-526dd6ff-b9c26fce-87a6″][vc_column_text]

The juicier characters are the stupid ones, the over-the-top characters, villains, nerds, the overly vain characters, and the ones that have a bizarre way of looking at the world. It’s not hard to get into those.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”How do you hire a character designer?” tab_id=”faqchar-1-2026″][vc_column_text css=””]

Send the brief — what the character is for, the medium it has to work in, and the style you are drawn to. Oddtoe takes character design for books, comics, games, animated series and films, either as a full commission or as a design pass over characters you already have.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”What does a character design service include?” tab_id=”faqchar-2-2026″][vc_column_text css=””]

Usually concept sketches, a settled character sheet, and the artwork a production needs to work from. Exact deliverables and the number of revision rounds are agreed with the brief so nothing is open-ended.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”What makes a good character designer?” tab_id=”faqchar-3-2026″][vc_column_text css=””]

Range, and judgement about which sketch is the one. A good character designer can push a face past realistic into something readable at a glance. Oddtoe leans to the over-the-top — villains, nerds, the overly vain, and characters with a bizarre way of looking at the world.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][/dfd_accordion][vc_raw_html][/vc_raw_html]
